notes: Pend Oreille County Commissioner District 2 is nominated by district and elected county-wide in the general (RCW 36.32.040, RCW 36.32.050(1)); Public Utility District No. 1 of Pend Oreille County covers the whole county (WA DOR PUD2025, layer 17) and every PUD voter elects each commissioner (RCW 54.12.010(3)). Both are scoped COUNTY.

The hospital bonds are scoped HOSPDST '1' (WA DOR HSP2025, layer 11; Ione and Metaline Falls are in Hospital District No. 2, outside), the Riverside levy SCHDST '62' (SCH2025, layer 20, the district's Pend Oreille part) and the Sacheen Lake levy SEWDST '3' (SEW2025, layer 21), DISTATTRIB.
